<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Sakib Sarker | SEO Expert, AEO &amp; GEO Specialist</title>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f6f7fb;--card:#fff;--text:#14183a;--muted:#5b6285;--line:#e3e6f2;--cy:#06b6d4;--pu:#7c3aed;--or:#f59e0b;--gr:#10b981;--bl:#2563eb;--pk:#ec4899;--rd:#ef4444;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);color-scheme:light}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#070a1c;--card:#0f1431;--text:#eef0ff;--muted:#a3a9cf;--line:#222859;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#070a1c;--card:#0f1431;--text:#eef0ff;--muted:#a3a9cf;--line:#222859;color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{height:100%;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.65}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(900px 400px at 85% 10%,#6d28d9 0,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 400px at 100% 100%,#06b6d4 0,transparent 55%),linear-gradient(135deg,#070a1c,#1b1166 60%,#2b1a7a);color:#fff;padding:56px 0 90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:0 0 48px 48px}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:32px;align-items:center}
.crumb{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#7dd3fc;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-size:clamp(42px,8vw,76px);line-height:1.02;margin:10px 0 8px;font-weight:800}
h1 span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22d3ee,#a78bfa,#f59e0b);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.sub{font-size:clamp(17px,2.6vw,24px);font-weight:600}.sub i{color:#f59e0b;font-style:normal;margin:0 6px}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:22px 0}
.pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btn{padding:11px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:#fff;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.li{background:#0a66c2}.md{background:#111;border:1px solid #444}.ig{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e4405f,#ec4899)}.fb{background:#1877f2}
.photo{position:relative;justify-self:center;width:min(320px,70vw);aspect-ratio:1}
.photo:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#06b6d4,#7c3aed,#f59e0b,#06b6d4);animation:spin 8s linear infinite}
.photo img{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:6px solid #0b1020;display:block}
.tag{position:absolute;right:-10px;bottom:6px;background:#f59e0b;color:#14183a;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:14px;transform:rotate(-6deg);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:-48px;position:relative}
.stat{border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;color:#fff;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(20,24,58,.25)}
.stat small{display:block;font-weight:400;opacity:.85;font-size:12px}.stat b{font-size:22px}
.s1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#2563eb)}.s2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6d28d9,#a78bfa)}.s3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d97706,#f59e0b)}.s4{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#10b981)}
section{margin:64px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,34px);margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:700}h2 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cy),var(--pu));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.lead{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 26px;font-size:15px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.about p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted)}.about p b{color:var(--text)}
.checks{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px}
.checks div{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-weight:500;font-size:15px}.checks div:last-child{border:0}.checks div:before{content:"\2714";color:#fff;background:var(--gr);border-radius:50%;width:22px;height:22px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;margin-right:10px}
.quote{margin-top:18px;border-left:4px solid var(--pu);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,58,237,.12),transparent);padding:16px 20px;border-radius:0 16px 16px 0}
.quote b{color:var(--pu);font-size:18px;display:block}.quote span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:4px solid var(--c);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(124,58,237,.18)}
.ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 16%,transparent);margin-bottom:12px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:16px;color:var(--c)}.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:16px}
.step{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;text-align:center}
.step i{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;background:var(--c);margin-bottom:10px}
.step h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:16px}.step p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:3px solid var(--c)}
.tl{position:relative;padding-left:26px;border-left:3px solid var(--line);margin-left:8px}
.ev{position:relative;margin-bottom:22px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 20px}
.ev:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-37px;top:22px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);border:4px solid var(--bg)}
.ev span{display:inline-block;background:var(--c);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 14px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ev p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}.ev p b{color:var(--text)}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#070a1c,#1b1166 55%,#0e7490);color:#fff;border-radius:32px;padding:48px 28px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:0}
.cta h2{color:#fff}.cta p{max-width:640px;margin:10px auto 24px;opacity:.9}.cta .btns{justify-content:center}
.cta small{display:block;margin-top:26px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;padding:22px 0 28px}
.rv{animation:up .8s both}@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:780px){.hero .wrap,.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.photo{order:-1}.hero{padding-top:36px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style></head><body>

<section><h2>About <em>Me</em></h2><p class="lead">SEO built on content, intent, and trust</p>
<div class="about"><div>
<p>I’m an SEO expert based in Bangladesh. For more than <b>seven years</b> I’ve helped e-commerce brands, SaaS companies, agencies, local businesses, and creators get found by the people who are actually searching for them. So far that adds up to <b>2,000+ SEO and content projects</b>.</p>
<p>My approach starts with <b>content and search intent</b>, then builds the technical, structural, and off-page work on top so the content can rank and keep ranking. More recently I’ve made <b>Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)</b> and <b>Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)</b> part of every engagement, because people now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI tools for recommendations, and businesses need to show up there too.</p>
<p>Most of my work is <b>long-term retainers</b>. I stay on to track algorithm updates, refresh underperforming pages, and adjust the strategy as search changes. Many clients come to me after being burned by keyword-stuffing “SEO experts”, so I clean up thin content and toxic backlinks first, then build sustainably on top.</p>
<div class="quote"><b>I work directly with every client.</b><span>No account managers, no outsourced writers, no black-box reporting. Every deliverable is something I did myself and can explain line by line.</span></div>
</div>
<div class="checks"><div>I help brands rank higher on Google</div><div>I help brands get recommended by AI</div><div>7+ Years &bull; 2,000+ Projects Completed</div><div>Technical SEO &bull; Local SEO &bull; AEO &bull; GEO</div></div>
</div></section>

<section><h2>SEO <em>Services</em></h2><p class="lead">Complete SEO solutions for sustainable growth</p>
<div class="grid">
<div class="card" style="--c:#2563eb"><div class="ic">&#9881;&#65039;</div><h3>Technical SEO</h3><p>Site audits, crawl and indexing fixes, Core Web Vitals, site structure, schema markup.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#7c3aed"><div class="ic">&#9999;&#65039;</div><h3>On-Page &amp; Content SEO</h3><p>Keyword research, search-intent mapping, content optimization, internal linking.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#f59e0b"><div class="ic">&#128279;</div><h3>Off-Page SEO</h3><p>White-hat link building, citations, authority growth built on relevance.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#10b981"><div class="ic">&#128205;</div><h3>Local SEO</h3><p>Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, map-pack visibility.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#ec4899"><div class="ic">&#128722;</div><h3>E-commerce SEO</h3><p>Category, product, and store-structure optimization for Shopify and WooCommerce.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#ef4444"><div class="ic">&#9654;&#65039;</div><h3>YouTube SEO</h3><p>Keyword targeting, titles, and descriptions for video ranking.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#8b5cf6"><div class="ic">&#129504;</div><h3>AEO &amp; GEO</h3><p>Helping AI assistants and answer engines find, understand, and recommend your brand.</p></div>
<div class="card" style="--c:#06b6d4"><div class="ic">&#128202;</div><h3>Tracking &amp; Reporting</h3><p>GA4, Google Search Console, and GTM setup for clear, measurable results.</p></div>
</div></section>

<section><h2>How I <em>Work</em></h2><p class="lead">A proven process for long-term results</p>
<div class="steps">
<div class="step" style="--c:#2563eb"><i>01</i><h3>Site Structure</h3><p>A clean, crawl-friendly foundation comes first.</p></div>
<div class="step" style="--c:#7c3aed"><i>02</i><h3>Search Intent</h3><p>Content mapped to what people really look for.</p></div>
<div class="step" style="--c:#f59e0b"><i>03</i><h3>Entity &amp; Schema</h3><p>Credibility that search engines and AI trust.</p></div>
<div class="step" style="--c:#10b981"><i>04</i><h3>Earned Links</h3><p>Authority built through relevance, not volume.</p></div>
